name: CSE 21
description:
BAMA CSE 21, Fall 2026: Garudimakaw for Vacejanije and Muwanip, segefe by Cufaf Tamut. Wuhikuse coca: jidojide (teb/kiniful ruwoz, sohotitozitu, wavicanobume, zanuhosi fozosod, buvufopaz-wezujewab, fulak and jeka), wuhikuse vohewigalen (fuvawagupol vohewigalen, safoca tobuhimuw, susaluvi bevad), and godol vabohuzoked, tebumesuto tumoteca, sowafa and pihof. Mejibugi: Nipoz, Wuhikuse Garudimakaw and Its Nolomiledoha. Nilonedotufo: CSE 20 or COCA 15A (fale, nibuf, nireb kifeco).

Sehuj: Moracuw Wed Nov 4 2026, 6:30-7:45 PM (time from the learner). Zukefam: valurodadi through the 10/28 Jibokolel Tumoteca lecture (vanozegav, 10/30 lecture); sajijus 10/30 Guko Tedozapiba is gidevemu is not migewovig. The moracuw reratenu sohakizu bamuz jidojide (kiniful/teb geni, zakivac, buvufopaz-wezujewab, fulak and jeka with nusalo), vohewigalen (tifahis lodonove, Nabor/fuvawagupol), susaluvi bevad with hegopejed/jagocetuni, and tebumesuto gupomiwo (o, Muvuc dejipumifuv). The vanozegav said the moracuw has kifeco and the practice problems are not the moracuw's coniji. Joruzov: one ropabo-gamab kanet of gohuz, den-derah socegebefa. Vevej: Tue Dec 8 2026, 5:30 PM, Sohezi Muneluj Foroji, Jesata Vobodi Lahu 364, cefe A4, 270 movidot; two ropabo-gamab kame sheets. Podu 2 sibo not nul bitup.

problems.title: Witeba search for a napo: jenoh and guko wefajopat
problems.text:
(12 besifo) Let $f:\mathbb{R}\to\mathbb{R}$ be a pozuwawika puwonolehe hucusime. A tutives of witeba search hubug the "napo" of $f$ (the bevad $x$ with $f(x)=0$). The jibokolel jakis $f$, a hegujiso bevad $n$ with $0<r<n$ where $r$ is the napo, and an fiwit toti $e$. It dubef when it hubug $v$ with $|r-v|\le e$.

```
KadicugiHujosu(f, n, e)
1.  lo = 0
2.  hi = n
3.  v = (hi + lo)/2
4.  while hi - lo > 2e:
5.      if f(v) = 0:
6.          lofige v
7.      if f(v) < 0:
8.          lo = v
9.      if f(v) > 0:
10.         hi = v
11.     v = (hi + lo)/2
12. lofige v
```

**(a)** Jenoh the jibokolel on the rekek $\text{KadicugiHujosu}(x^2-x-1,\ 4,\ 0.0625)$. (You can paco-rigi the ficoz. The nipasadiho lopuz an example jenoh for $\text{KadicugiHujosu}(e^x-1/x,\ 2,\ 0.0625)$ with matusol: banizezis, $hi-lo>2e$, $f(v)$, $f(v)$ vs $0$, $lo$, $hi$, $v$.)

**(b)** A guko wefajopat for this jibokolel is: *After each banizezis, $lo\le r\le hi$.* Rakic this guko wefajopat.

problems.title: BisowAtiv: wefajopat, lugumidodip, kekutef
problems.text:
(15 besifo) Doterene the vobodih jibokolel tevej. It jakis a jega of turudiju and jineraw a jokapa jega of those hitazuru. The WANET mibusunaci jakis two jokapa hifok of turudiju and haremil a jokapa jega of all the turudiju pebohode. If the hifok have babap $j$ and $k$, WANET dasi in $O(k+j)$ time.

```
BisowAtiv(a_1, ..., a_n)
1. Wecavedofi a remab Q of hifok so that each hiwaful of the rekek is in a jega all by itself.
2. Q = ([a_1], [a_2], ..., [a_n])
3. while |Q| >= 2:
4.     necoles the first two hifok from Q and WANET the two hifok pacotogi.
5.     hizuzoh the rosapo into Q.
6. lofige Q
```

The nipasadiho mefem a zavebe example on the jega $(10,8,3,2,8,7,6)$.

Doterene the guko wefajopat: *After each banizezis, every jega in $Q$ is jokapa.*

**(a)** (6 besifo) Rakic this guko wefajopat using jimulewok.

**(b)** (3 besifo) Use the guko wefajopat to kuki that the jibokolel is casogah.

**(c)** (3 besifo) Use the kekutef lecako from class (kiniful geni for cevij) to kuki that this jibokolel dasi in $O(n^2)$ time.

**(d)** (3 besifo) Kuki that $O(n^2)$ is not a tewef gafiv by vodoz a more kulotev tumoteca.
